_comment: Vendor public keys this build trusts, keyed by keyId. Generated by `npm run keygen`, which writes the real trusted-keys.json beside this file and merges rather than replaces — rotating a key must leave certificates already in the field verifiable. Only public halves ever appear here; the private key stays on the licence server. Without this file an installation runs in SETUP and cannot activate, which is the correct behaviour for a source checkout.
